rubric:
A fill-to-contour (no empty gap inside the contour, esp. bottom) ·
B cutout-fit (empty cutout=clean bg + bleed margin + rim/bevel; feature cutout=painted feature on the cut) ·
C keep-clear (NO focal motif inside a red zone) · D top-contour (top silhouette follows the green guide) ·
E arch-fit (door/window/landmark fits the orange arch + door-flap lines) ·
F margins/seams (bleed margin; no focal element split by a blue fold / panel seam) ·
G style (one coherent painted illustration, not collage). No guide lines baked into art.
VERDICT=PASS only if A-F hold AND G ok; else FAIL + failing checks + one fix.
instruction: Open overlay + every crop. Apply the rubric. Return {verdict, failing_checks[], reasons[], one_fix}.
